note: Sections 8/9: pre-registered quality-evaluation methodology, written BEFORE any quality comparison run at PRIMARY POINT B (ctx=180000) was executed. This file exists specifically so the 5-prompt subset selection cannot be accused of being chosen after seeing results.
why_5_not_10: Section 8 permits a pre-registered deterministic 5-prompt subset when the full 10-prompt holdout set is prohibitively expensive at the target context. At ctx=180000 on this shared, memory-constrained host (5.6GiB total RAM, real GTX 1650 4GiB VRAM, ~68MB of the product's own conservative Q5 headroom -- see boundary_scan.json point_b_primary_constrained), each sequential_compare dump/compare invocation performs a real full model load plus a real ~2.7-2.9GB VRAM context allocation. Running all 10 holdout prompts across 1 reference dump + 6 candidate configs (whole-Q5 self-check, profile-mixed top-8, 4 naive top-8 layouts) would mean 10 dumps + 60 compares = 70 heavy sequential GPU allocations; 5 prompts reduces this to 5 dumps + 30 compares = 35, a scope judged necessary given real host RAM headroom observed at the time of this run (free -h showed under 700MiB available, see hardware_state.json / this session's live checks) alongside other concurrent processes on the same shared machine.
subset_selection_rule: The first 5 of the existing, already-committed 10-item Phase 11C/11D holdout list (results/phase11/generalization/prompts.json, train_holdout_split.holdout), taken in the fixed order that list is already written in. No result of any kind (from this phase or any config) was consulted to make this selection -- it is a pure prefix of a pre-existing, already-committed ordered list.
gen_tokens_rationale: Matches the gen_tokens=32 convention used consistently across all prior Phase 11B/11C/11D quality measurements (see e.g. results/phase11/model-specific-policy/raw_holdout_policy_360m.jsonl, performance.json) -- not a new value chosen for this phase.

reference_definition.why: At ctx=180000 (PRIMARY POINT B) even a single whole-cache Q8 context cannot safely allocate (see boundary_scan.json point_b_primary_constrained.explicit_q8, exit_code=5, real product rejection) -- an F16 reference would need roughly 2x Q8's KV bytes and fails even more clearly. Fabricating a high-context F16/Q8 reference would be dishonest; none is used.
reference_definition.reference_used: whole-cache Q5_1 (GGML_TYPE_Q5_1), gpu-layers all, ctx=180000 -- this is the real product fallback this phase measures against (whole-cache Q5 IS what --kv adaptive actually selects at this ctx; see boundary_scan.json adaptive.selected_kv=q5).
reference_definition.methodology: membrane-kv-sequential-compare --mode dump captures the whole-cache-Q5 run's own free-running generation (tokens + per-step logits) to a file, then exits, freeing its context before any other process opens a new one (never two live GPU contexts at once, avoiding real OOM risk at this tight a headroom). --mode compare then loads each candidate config (whole-Q5 self-check as a sanity control, profile-mixed top-8, and naive top-8 layouts) in its own separate process, teacher-forces over the dumped Q5 run's own token sequence, and reports top1_preservation / logit_rel_l2 / delta_nll against the dumped Q5 logits, plus a free-running pass for token_identity/first_divergence -- the same trio of metrics every other MEMBRANE Q8/Q5 quality tool in this repo reports, just computed via two sequential single-context processes instead of one dual-context process.
reference_definition.labeling_requirement: All quality artifacts from this phase must describe this explicitly as 'candidate vs whole-cache-Q5' or 'mixed vs Q5', never as 'vs Q8' or 'vs F16' or 'vs ground truth' -- Q5 is the real, measured reference used, not a proxy for a higher-precision ground truth that was never obtained at this context.

layouts_compared_at_q8_count_8.A_profile_sensitivity: top-8 most sensitive layers per profile_360m_train21.json: [1, 13, 18, 19, 23, 24, 25, 30] (identical to boundary_scan.json / q8_count_sweep.json's own q8_count=8 layer list)
layouts_compared_at_q8_count_8.D_alternating: every 4th layer starting at 0, 8 of them: [0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28]
layouts_compared_at_q8_count_8.E_random_seeded: deterministic seeded random, seed=42, matching the seed convention already used in results/phase11/model-specific-policy/holdout_policy_360m.json's E_random layout -- exact index list recorded at run time in quality_raw.jsonl since it depends on the RNG implementation used to generate it
layouts_compared_at_q8_count_8.F_all_q5: the whole-cache-Q5 self-check control (q8_count=0) -- expected near-perfect self-agreement, included as a sanity check on the sequential dump/compare methodology itself, not as a novel data point
